title: Route writes before choosing a row key
description: Select a workload and key shape, then raise write pressure. The model shows region skew, the hottest server load, and how many regions a range query must contact.

workloads.label: Global event timeline
workloads.detail: Writes arrive from many producers; the common read is a global time window.
workloads.queryLabel: All events from the last hour

workloads.label: Per-device history
workloads.detail: Each device appends measurements; readers usually fetch one device over a time range.
workloads.queryLabel: One device for the last 24 hours

workloads.label: Skewed tenant ledger
workloads.detail: One large tenant produces nearly half of all writes and needs ordered account history.

strategies.label: Timestamp first
strategies.detail: Keeps a global time window contiguous, but every new key lands at the end of the table.

strategies.label: Salt + timestamp
strategies.detail: Spreads appends across fixed buckets; time scans must issue one range per salt bucket.

strategies.label: Entity + reverse time
strategies.detail: Keeps one entity's recent history together, while a dominant entity can still heat one region.

strategies.label: Hash the complete key
strategies.detail: Balances exact-key traffic well, but destroys useful ordering for range scans.
